faq.q: Do I have to buy a package, or can I start with one service?
faq.a: Start with one. Most clients begin with a single project — a website, a brand identity, a marketplace onboarding — and add channels once the first one is working. Every service page lists what it includes on its own.

faq.q: Which services are one-time projects and which are monthly?
faq.a: Branding, websites, Shopify builds, catalogues, films and onboarding are one-time projects. Social media, ads management, SEO/AEO/GEO, store management and marketplace or quick-commerce account management are monthly retainers. Each service page shows its engagement model in the At a glance strip.
Yes. Strategy, design, video, AI production, copy, development, media buying and marketplace operations are in-house. For influencer campaigns we bring in creators from our network.
